melatonin (MT)-cyclodextrin (CD) complexation was found to improve the solubility, dissolution and nasal absorption of melatonin.

the inclusion complex of melatonin with modified cyclodextins (CDs), namely, hydroxypropyl β-CD and randomly methylated-β-CD, were formed in solution and solid phases, which resulted in improved solubility of melatonin in water and improved nasal permeation of melatonin from hydroxypropylmethyl cellulose gel formulations.
the formation of MT inclusion complex with CDs has been demonstrated in solution and in solid state.

the effect of CDs on MT solubility and permeation across nasal epithelium.
the effect of cyclodextrins on solubility and permeability of MT and the findings of this work are useful to develop nasal formulations of melatonin.
the effect of cyclodextrins on complexation and nasal permeation of melatonin.

CDs can be used for improving the solubilization and nasal permeation of MT.
the use of CDs at low concentrations (1%w/v) can significantly improve nasal permeability of melatonin.
CDs can be used for solubility enhancement and nasal delivery of melatonin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inclusion complexation of MT with CDs was found to be useful in improving the solubilization and nasal absorption of melatonin.
inclusion complexation with HPβCD at 1 to 2% w/v concentration would be a suitable approach for the formulation of nasal MT delivery system.
the inclusion complexation of MT with HP β CD and RMβ CD can significantly improve the solubility, and nasal absorption of the drug.

CDs can be used as a permeation enhancer for nasal delivery of hydrophobic drugs.
the use of CDs at relatively low concentration (1% wv) can be used to improve the nasal delivery of MT from HPMCP gel formulations.
